Most altcoin holders are still sitting on losses. The median coin has less than a quarter of its supply in profit. Global market tops tend to occur once a majority of supply across the entire market is deep in profit. That point is still a long way off.

$BTC has flashed the momentum signal that started the last two bull markets. MVRV has crossed back above its 365-day average. This is the same cross that we saw in 2019 and 2023 at the beginning of each bull market.
$BTC has reclaimed every one of its long-term moving averages. After around 300 days underneath them, this dynamic has now flipped. Holding above them is what maintains a long-term uptrend.
